---
title: Browse the code
description: Open Code in Console to inspect project files.
sidebar:
  order: 8
---

In the project top bar, open **Console**. Under the APP group, click **Code**. You can browse files and open them to read.

This is for checking what the AI just changed. You do not have to edit files by hand to finish a build. Day-to-day changes still go through chat on the left.

Console also has **Assets** for images and files saved in the project.
